title: Tofu peanut noodles
summary: Tofu peanut noodles is a thai dinner built around firm tofu and rice noodles, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Slice firm tofu and rice noodles before the pan is hot. Tofu peanut noodles is a fast cook, so have the sauce measured too.
steps.tip: A crowded wok steams. Cook the protein in two batches if the pan looks full.

steps.instruction: If the dish includes a grain or noodles, start them now in salted water so they are ready when the stir-fry is.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry firm tofu until just cooked. Scoop it onto a plate.

Fry the garlic and ginger, add rice noodles and peanut butter, return firm tofu, and toss with the sauce for a minute. Taste Tofu peanut noodles before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice noodles, simmered in salted water until tender.

image.alt: Tofu peanut noodles served for dinner
